_meta.host: AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 w/ Radeon 860M (16 cores)
_meta.note:
Batch forwarding measured with a receiver that drains the aggregation channel. The benchmark previously left MaxBufferedGradients unset (0), so once the 10000-slot channel filled every further gradient was dropped and the number described a path that aggregated nothing -- main logged 0 warnings only because its client was too slow to fill the channel.

Progression for BatchForwarding (10 x 1000-dim gradients):
  9827786 ns / 10368 allocs  original
  5256936 ns / 10301 allocs  after sizing encodeGradient (PR #200)
  338578  ns / 294   allocs  after pre-sizing the batch body and bulk-reading the decode path

GradientForwarding is unchanged at 523805 ns / 1031 allocs; it sends one gradient per call so the batch-body and bulk-decode paths do not apply.
